name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_battle_* convention; reflects domain (battle enemy-turn AI), purpose (priority-enemy spell-score multiplier), and data type (scalar double). The _15 suffix encodes the constant VALUE 1.5 (semantic), not a Ghidra address residue: the address 0x50144 contains no '15', and sibling multiplier globals follow the same decimal-point-removed value-encoding convention (data_fd2_battle_spell_ap_boost_factor_015 = 0.15, _dp_boost_factor_015 = 0.15). Keep.
purpose: Priority-enemy spell-score multiplier (1.5) applied by the enemy-turn AI when scoring a basic damage spell against a high-priority enemy target.
logic_summary: Single READ from fd2_score_spell_candidate @ 0x15bc3 (FMUL double ptr [0x50144]). In the basic-damage-spell branch (spell_id < 0xd), for each target whose runtime_char bChar_id (+0x08) == 0 (high-priority enemy), the integer per-target score (8 for a hit, 0x18 for a kill shot) is loaded via FILD, multiplied by this 1.5 double, and rounded back to int via FISTP -- boosting the AI's preference for hitting priority enemies by 50%.
element_semantics: Scalar IEEE-754 double constant = 1.5 (bytes 00 00 00 00 00 00 f8 3f = 0x3FF8000000000000). Used as a 1.5x score multiplier.
notes: src comment block (btltab.c lines 11-20) already accurate and precise (purpose, single reader, FILD/FMUL qword/FISTP sequence, value 1.5, read-only) -> kept verbatim. Ghidra data PLATE_COMMENT was null -> created a concise plate via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism, content derived from src conclusion.
